title: Add command to change issue type
description:
Support converting issues between types (e.g., promoting a usecase to an epic, or demoting an epic to a usecase).

Use case: Sometimes you create an issue and later realize it should be a different type:
- A usecase grows and should become an epic
- An epic is too small and should be a usecase
- A bug turns out to be a ux_problem

Command: pebbles convert <id> <new-type>

Implementation considerations:
- Validate type transitions (e.g., converting epic with children?)
- Update filename to reflect new type short code
- Update issue_type field
- Create jj change describing the conversion
